---
name: Template submission
about: Propose or submit a new DESIGN.md design-system template for the gallery
title: "[template]: "
labels: ["template", "enhancement"]
---

### Template Overview

- **System Name:** e.g., `Raycast`
- **Suggested Slug:** e.g., `raycast`
- **Primary Theme:** `dark` / `light` / `mixed`
- **Platform:** `desktop-web` / `mobile-web` / `ios` / `android`
- **Live Reference Website:** e.g., `https://raycast.com`
- **Aesthetic / Mood Tags:** e.g., `monochrome, developer-tools, sleek, high-contrast`

---

### Key Colors & Typography

- **Dominant Colors:** (e.g., `#0F0F11`, `#FF6363`)
- **Primary Font Family:** (e.g., `Inter, system-ui, sans-serif`)

---

### Checklist

- [ ] Template describes the visual language and tokens only (no proprietary logos or brand copy)
- [ ] Color values have been verified for syntax correctness
- [ ] Ready to open a PR adding `content/templates/<slug>.md`
